name: Da Lat food guide
summary: Bánh căn off a charcoal pan, a hot xíu mại bowl, lá é chicken hotpot, and strawberries on the market slope.
body: Da Lat eats from the slope above Xuan Huong Lake and from the stalls in the centre. Morning can be a hot bowl of bánh mì xíu mại, bánh căn off a charcoal pan, or rice sheets with chicken. Afternoon is avocado ice cream, eaten cold while you stand. After dark the night market grills a rice sheet and pours hot soy milk.

Vietnam Tourism says the town changes the dishes newcomers brought, and cooks what the farms grow: avocado, strawberry, asparagus, artichoke, grape, tea, coffee, and wild mountain mushrooms. What follows are the dishes and the preserved foods those articles, and Visit Lâm Đồng, actually print. Mì Quảng, bún bò Huế, Hanoi-style phở with lettuce, bánh bèo, bánh xèo, and Phan Rang chicken rice are the other plates those articles name.
The coast is a different meal. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism puts Nha Trang and Mui Ne a few hours away by car. The minutes are Check on arrival.
specialtiesLead: Vietnam Tourism names the charcoal bánh căn, the hot xíu mại, the market fruit, the artichoke tea, and the persimmons. Visit Lâm Đồng names the night stalls, the lá é hotpot, bánh ướt lòng gà, the clay-pot rice, and the doors under each line. A figure with no source is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Market snacks
paragraphs: These are the cups, sheets, and jars from the market slope, the night stalls, and the orchards. Where a page prints a price, it is under the line. Where it does not, the price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Avocado ice cream
spots.address: Market slope, the night market, and 76 Nguyễn Văn Trỗi
spots.note: Blended avocado, eaten cold from a cup. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism names it as a Da Lat sweet and does not print a stall price. Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note prints 20,000–30,000 VND at 76 Nguyễn Văn Trỗi.

spots.name: Grilled rice paper
spots.note: A crisp rice sheet grilled with toppings. Fold it and eat from the paper. The night-market listing does not print a stall price. The food-tour note prints 10,000–30,000 VND. Stalls run about 18:00–23:00.

spots.name: Strawberry with condensed milk
spots.note: Fresh strawberries with sweet milk, a cup or a bag at Da Lat Market in the daytime. The address, the hours, and the stall price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Hot soy milk
spots.address: Market, the night market, and 64 Tăng Bạt Hổ
spots.note: Sweet hot soy milk for a cool evening. The food-tour note prints 10,000 VND at 64 Tăng Bạt Hổ and says that counter also sells other soy milks, without naming them. Night stalls run about 18:00–23:00.

spots.name: Artichoke tea
spots.note: Herbal tea from local artichoke, hot or bottled to take home. Vietnam Tourism Information lists it as a Lam Dong specialty. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Crab soup
spots.address: Night market and Lam Vien Square
spots.note: Hot crab soup at the night market and Lam Vien Square. Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note prints 10,000–15,000 VND. A stall number is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Grilled skewers
spots.note: Skewers at the night market. The food-tour note prints 10,000–20,000 VND. The night-market listing does not print a skewer price, and the meats are not listed. Stalls run about 18:00–23:00.

spots.name: Yaourt phô mai
spots.address: Tăng Bạt Hổ, Yersin, Hoàng Diệu, and Phạm Nhật Duật
spots.note: A cold yogurt cup named with bánh căn and with morning xíu mại. One note prints 5,000 VND for yaourt and does not say phô mai. The bánh căn listings name yaourt phô mai without that figure. A single price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bánh flan phô mai
spots.note: Cheese flan named at 7 Tăng Bạt Hổ and at Bánh Căn Lệ on Yersin. A price is Check on arrival. Hours follow that door: 16:00–23:00 or 06:00–19:00.

spots.name: Wind-dried persimmon
spots.note: Hung and wind-dried. Vietnam Tourism puts the orchards at the end of Mimosa Pass, off Trần Hưng Đạo and Khe Sanh, and calls it a famous Da Lat specialty. The season lines are late October and November, and also September through December. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Dried persimmon
spots.address: Mimosa Pass, and shops in town
spots.note: Chewy dried persimmon. Vietnam Tourism lists hồng sấy. The provincial center describes hồng sấy dẻo as a highland sweet, Da Lat included. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Soft ripe persimmon
spots.note: Soft ripe persimmon, named by Vietnam Tourism with the other persimmon specialties. The price is Check on arrival. Orchards are at the end of Mimosa Pass.

spots.name: Pressed persimmon
spots.address: Mimosa Pass, or a shop in town
spots.note: Pressed persimmon. Vietnam Tourism names it and does not describe the press. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Crunchy persimmon
spots.address: Mimosa Pass and Cau Dat orchards
spots.note: Crunchy persimmon from the orchards, bought as a gift. Season lines disagree: late October and November, or September through December. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Strawberry jam
spots.note: Mildly sweet strawberry jam at a seasonal fair in a Cam Ly resort yard. A shop address and the price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Candied ginger
spots.note: Candied ginger at the market fringe, with preserved fruit, coffee, and artichoke tea. The price is Check on arrival. A stall number is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Fruit preserves
spots.note: Fruit preserves at the market fringe. Vietnam Tourism calls them famous Da Lat preserves. Fruits inside the jars, other than the strawberry jam, were not listed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Da Lat wine
spots.note: Wine from Da Lat grapes and local fruit. Wikipedia, citing a 2009 business-forum piece, puts the first bottle in 1999. A shop address and the price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Da Lat strawberries
spots.note: Fresh strawberries. The condensed-milk cup is dâu sữa. A 2025 provincial bulletin names dâu tây Đà Lạt. The kilogram price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Artichoke extract
spots.note: Cooked-down artichoke, named in a March 2025 Lam Dong bulletin, separate from the tea. A shop address and the price are Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Cooked specialties
paragraphs: These are the plates Visit Lâm Đồng and Vietnam Tourism name for a day in Da Lat. Door prices that disagree are both printed. A plate with no figure of its own is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bánh căn
spots.note: Grilled over charcoal with a quail egg or a duck egg. Vietnam Tourism says the centre, especially Hoa Binh, in the early morning. Visit Lâm Đồng door prices are 15,000–30,000 VND, 20,000–50,000 VND, and “Đang cập nhật”. A single city price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bánh mì xíu mại
spots.address: 26 Hoàng Diệu and 26 Phạm Nhật Duật
spots.note: Hot pork-meatball broth, a grilled baguette, shredded papaya, and herbs. Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note prints about 10,000–15,000 VND a bowl at 26 Hoàng Diệu and 26 Phạm Nhật Duật. Hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bánh ướt lòng gà
spots.address: Phan Đình Phùng and Tăng Bạt Hổ
spots.note: White rice sheets with shredded chicken, bone, thigh, offal, and trứng non. Visit Lâm Đồng prints 25,000–100,000 VND across four doors on Phan Đình Phùng and Tăng Bạt Hổ. Hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Lẩu gà lá é
spots.address: 3 Tháng 4, Chu Văn An, and Yersin
spots.note: Chicken hotpot with lá é. Tao Ngộ and 668 print 20,000–100,000 VND a person. Hạnh, 6 Yersin, prints 200,000–350,000 VND and is open 10:00–23:00. The leaf is compared there to cinnamon in look and lemongrass in smell.

spots.name: Cơm niêu
spots.address: Hồ Tùng Mậu, Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa, and Sương Nguyệt Ánh
spots.note: Clay-pot rice with a thin crust. Four doors print four bands: 40,000–200,000 VND, 30,000–380,000 VND, 12,000–60,000 VND, and 30,000–55,000 VND. Hours are printed door by door from 09:00 or 10:00 until 21:00 or 22:00.

spots.name: Cơm lam
spots.address: Toward Langbiang, or Cu Lan village
spots.note: Bamboo-tube rice with sesame salt, eaten toward Langbiang or in Cu Lan village, with grilled forest meat, grilled chicken, and grilled eggs. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Nem nướng
spots.address: 5 Trần Phú and 45 Bùi Thị Xuân
spots.note: Grilled pork with bánh tráng phơi sương, herbs, and a house sauce. Bà Hùng at 5 Trần Phú prints 45,000 VND. Bà Nghĩa at 45 Bùi Thị Xuân prints 45,000–70,000 VND. Hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bánh giò
spots.address: 26 Hoàng Diệu and 26 Phạm Nhật Duật
spots.note: A side cake at the xíu mại counters. Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note prints 6,000 VND. A filling list was not printed. Hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Chả cây
spots.address: Tăng Bạt Hổ, Yersin, Hoàng Diệu, and Phạm Nhật Duật
spots.note: A pork stick with bánh căn or xíu mại. Cây Bơ prints 5,000 VND for chả cây. The food-tour note prints 4,000 VND for chả. The two names are kept apart.

spots.name: Gà nướng lu
spots.note: Chicken roasted in a lu at Lẩu gà lá é 668, 2B Chu Văn An. A price for the roast alone is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Lòng gà xào nấm
spots.note: Chicken offal stir-fried with mushrooms at 2B Chu Văn An. The mushrooms are not named. The price is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Grilled forest meat
spots.address: Toward Langbiang, or Cu Lan village
spots.note: Grilled forest meat with cơm lam toward Langbiang or in Cu Lan village. The animal is not named. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Grilled chicken
spots.address: Langbiang side, Cu Lan, and 7 Tô Hiến Thành
spots.note: Grilled chicken toward Langbiang or in Cu Lan, and at 7 Tô Hiến Thành, open 10:00–22:00. A price for the plate alone is Check on arrival. The door band at Số 7 is 50,000–200,000 VND.

spots.name: Grilled chicken eggs
spots.address: Toward Langbiang, or Cu Lan village
spots.note: Grilled eggs with cơm lam toward Langbiang or in Cu Lan village. The price is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Stuffed snails
spots.note: Stuffed snails at 33 Hai Bà Trưng. The stuffing is not described. The price is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Oxtail hotpot
spots.note: Oxtail hotpot at 33 Hai Bà Trưng. The broth is not described. The price is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Chicken herbal stew
spots.note: Chicken stewed with ginseng and Chinese herbs at Tài Ký, 39 Bùi Thị Xuân. The note prints 50,000 VND a pot. Hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Pigeon herbal stew
spots.note: Pigeon stewed with ginseng and Chinese herbs at 39 Bùi Thị Xuân. The note prints 50,000 VND a pot. Hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Beef-tendon herbal stew
spots.note: Beef tendon stewed with ginseng and Chinese herbs at 39 Bùi Thị Xuân. The note prints 50,000 VND a pot. Hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Pork-tendon herbal stew
spots.note: Pork tendon stewed with ginseng and Chinese herbs at 39 Bùi Thị Xuân. The note prints 50,000 VND a pot. Hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Pork-brain herbal stew
spots.note: Pork brain stewed with ginseng and Chinese herbs at 39 Bùi Thị Xuân. The note prints 50,000 VND a pot. Hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ngọc hành herbal stew
spots.note: Ngọc hành stewed with ginseng and Chinese herbs at 39 Bùi Thị Xuân. The note does not define ngọc hành. It prints 50,000 VND a pot. Hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Artichoke with pork hock
spots.note: Artichoke stewed with pork hock at cơm niêu Việt Nam, 3h Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa, open 09:00–22:00. A price for the plate alone is Check on arrival. The door prints 30,000–380,000 VND.

spots.name: Lẩu tả pín lù
spots.note: Named at cơm niêu Việt Nam, 3h Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa, open 09:00–22:00. The note does not say what is in the pot. A price for the pot alone is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Boiled chicken
spots.note: Boiled gà ta at 7 Tô Hiến Thành, open 10:00–22:00. A price for the plate alone is Check on arrival. The door prints 50,000–200,000 VND.

spots.name: Chicken steamed with fish sauce
spots.note: Chicken steamed with fish sauce at 7 Tô Hiến Thành, open 10:00–22:00. A price for the plate alone is Check on arrival. The door prints 50,000–200,000 VND.

spots.name: Tile-grilled meat
spots.note: Grilled on a tile at Cu Đức, 6A Nguyễn Lương Bằng. The note prints 100,000–200,000 VND a person and does not list the meats. Hours are Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Regional dishes
paragraphs: Vietnam Tourism says people who moved here brought central dishes, and that Da Lat cooks change them for the weather and the farms. These are the central plates, and the Phan Rang chicken rice, that the same sources name in town.

spots.name: Bánh bèo
spots.address: 68 Phan Đình Phùng, and streetside stalls
spots.note: Vietnam Tourism says the Hue cake is rice and tapioca, steamed in a small bowl, with light fish sauce, fried shallots, chili, and crispy pork skin, as a morning or afternoon snack. The street-lunch line adds river shrimp. Visit Lâm Đồng names bánh bèo at 68 Phan Đình Phùng on a board printed at 27,000–35,000 VND, not split by dish. A price for the cake alone is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bánh xèo
spots.note: Vietnam Tourism names bánh xèo among central dishes cooked in Da Lat and does not describe the cake. Visit Lâm Đồng says Nem nướng bà Nghĩa at 45 Bùi Thị Xuân also sells it. That door prints 45,000–70,000 VND and does not split the figure. A price for the cake alone is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bún bò Huế
spots.address: Phù Đổng Thiên Vương, Hồ Tùng Mậu, and the market fountain
spots.note: The food-tour note calls it a hot morning bowl and says it shares beef, black sauce, and satay chili with the phở. Bún công at 1c Phù Đổng Thiên Vương is about 35,000 VND. Bún bò Thiên Trang at 2 Hồ Tùng Mậu is 30,000–40,000 VND. Ấp Ánh Sáng, by the fountain in front of Da Lat Market, has no price in that note. Hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Phở bò
spots.address: Tăng Bạt Hổ and Nguyễn Văn Cừ
spots.note: Vietnam Tourism says the Da Lat bowl is Hanoi-style phở plus herbs and crisp lettuce. The food-tour note prints 30,000–45,000 VND at 23 Tăng Bạt Hổ and 25,000–30,000 VND at 2/8 Nguyễn Văn Cừ. Hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Mì Quảng
spots.address: Upper floor of Da Lat Market
spots.note: Vietnam Tourism describes a pork-knuckle broth with turmeric noodles inside the market, and says cooks on the upper floor assemble the bowls through the day. A price is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Cơm gà Phan Rang
spots.note: The food-tour note points at Phan Rang chicken rice at 28 Trần Nhật Duật and does not describe the plate. It is Phan Rang’s dish. The price is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Casual dining
paragraphs: The two doors are the day market on the slope and the night market in the centre. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism describes the day stalls as flowers and produce. Visit Lâm Đồng puts the night stalls at about 18:00–23:00.

spots.name: Da Lat Market
spots.caption: Morning produce and strawberries on the slope above the lake.
spots.note: Morning flowers, produce, and strawberry cups on the slope above Xuan Huong Lake. The door is free. Visit Lâm Đồng does not print the address or the hours. Both are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Da Lat Night Market
spots.caption: Lit counters for grilled rice paper and soy milk.
spots.note: Grilled rice paper, hot soy milk, and skewers under the lights. Visit Lâm Đồng puts the stalls at about 18:00–23:00. A street number is Check on arrival. Printed prices for those snacks are on their lines.

sections.heading: Breakfast
paragraphs: The hot Da Lat breakfast is bánh mì xíu mại, in small bowls, with the baguette on the side. A cold-cut bánh mì is the ordinary sandwich. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism does not print a Da Lat-only filling list for that loaf.

seoTitle: Da Lat food guide — bánh căn, xíu mại, lá é hotpot
seoDescription: Da Lat food from Vietnam Tourism and Visit Lâm Đồng: bánh căn, bánh mì xíu mại, lá é chicken hotpot, market fruit, and persimmon. An unprinted price is Check on arrival.
